description: Implementation of NativeJS functionality for WPEFramework plugin, managing application lifecycle and rendering via NativeJSRenderer.

classes.name: NativeJSImplementation
classes.description: Class implementing native JavaScript application management within WPEFramework plugin.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the renderer with a Wayland display, starts rendering thread.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Terminates the renderer and joins rendering thread.

methods.name: CreateApplication
methods.description: Creates a new application with specified options, returns application ID.

methods.name: RunApplication
methods.description: Runs an application with given ID and URL.

methods.name: RunJavaScript
methods.description: Executes JavaScript code in the context of the specified application.

methods.name: TerminateApplication
methods.description: Terminates the application with the specified ID.
